compatibility_repairs: Added tensorflow-cpu because experiments/libero/libero_utils.py imports TensorFlow but the top-level README does not install it.
Added the LIBERO simulator runtime dependencies omitted by experiments/LIBERO/setup.py.
Pinned NumPy 1.26.4 and OpenCV 4.11.0.86 for the Python 3.11-compatible LIBERO stack.
Set LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH inside baselines/spr/runtime to avoid the upstream first-import interactive prompt.
known_metadata_conflicts_not_used_by_eva: pyproject.toml declares transformers 4.52.3 while the official evaluation README explicitly requires 4.52.1; the README pin is used.
Training-only beaker, wandb, and Google packages request newer protobuf than vLLM 0.8.5; checkpoint evaluation uses vLLM's protobuf 4.25.9.
